description: Original Rust Garden JS reference before material-tine redesign; no output gain or worklet transport applied.
eventPolicy: manual strike at frame 0; first random strike at first block boundary >= round(sampleRate/rateHz); each next due frame = actual previous event frame + round(sampleRate/rateHz); exactly six random strikes
checkpointLayout: [frame,left,right], rounded to 10 decimal places (<=5e-11 rounding error); waveform hashes are provenance only, not cross-kernel assertions
